checks: Local PDF canvas and selectable text render; selection lookup saves word, meaning, filename, page and fingerprint without uploading the PDF
PDF zoom and source metadata survive backup export/import without duplicating favorites
Opening a local favorite requests its original file, rejects mismatched files and restores the correct PDF page
Image-only PDFs show an OCR limitation and invalid PDF/login-page bytes are rejected
Password-protected PDF opens locally; its password is cleared and excluded from backups
Extension shortcut handler reads selected text inside its own PDF reader without relying on content-script injection
Online PDF opens in the reader; Microsoft requery sends only the selected word and retains PDF URL/page metadata
Shortcut dispatch targets the focused cross-origin document frame, supports semantic document editors and avoids duplicate floating icons
Selection context-menu handler opens a real lookup while preserving available PDF page information
